plugin.name: fal.ai
plugin.description: fal.ai's image, video, audio and 3D models, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds fal.ai to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings: FLUX.1 [schnell] makes pictures, Kling O3 makes videos of 3 to 15 seconds from a first frame (and a last one if you give it), MiniMax Speech-02 HD reads text aloud, Stable Audio makes sound effects and music, and TRELLIS makes a 3D model from a picture. fal.ai bills each request to your account. To use more of fal.ai's models, choose Load models on its page in Settings and turn on the ones you want. BiRefNet removes image backgrounds from the canvas while preserving the source dimensions and colors. This is separate from AI redraw cutout and requires OhMyGame API 2.27. Stable Audio 2.5 adds WAV sound effects and music from 1 to 190 seconds. The older Stable Audio model and your saved choices remain available.
